accessBoundary.network: Dispatcharr and Otpravkarr share the VPN sidecar network namespace

automationOwnership.forbidden: hard delete or second quarantine owner

automationOwnership.owner: EPG Janitor with explicit source allowlist

maintenanceSequence: Verify VPN health and shared egress
Verify same-phase Dispatcharr and coherent Otpravkarr backups
Refresh healthy provider M3U and EPG; keep custom M3U disabled
Run Lineuparr validation and bounded apply
Run IPTV Checker at concurrency two; halve or stop above 20 percent failures
Run Stream-Mapparr preview and measured ordering
Preview Channel Mapparr and sample one backed-up channel when no true preview exists
Run source-scoped EPG Janitor dry-run; leave low-confidence matches unapplied
Use EPGeditARR only for approved missing event data
Run Event Channel Managarr status and rescan
Reconcile Otpravkarr; assert level 1 and a non-empty profile list
Run authorized and unauthorized M3U, XMLTV, and XC checks; inspect redacted logs

rollback.method: Restore the recorded prior image digest with its compatible pre-migration SQLite backup, restore saved Compose and authorized Caddy blocks, validate Caddy, restart, then verify integrity, counts, and access.
rollback.prohibition: Never downgrade code against migrations 003 or 004

subscriber level 10 or empty remote channel_profiles
credential material in logs or artifacts
unexpected SQLite creation or image digest drift
plugin applied delta above preview or recurring delete count above zero
